title: Explorations in Arts and Humanities; Critical Conversations in Music
description:
Restricted to first semester first year students in the College of Arts and Humanities.

This course will use the common language of music to encourage students to approach scholarly research and writing in new ways. As a class, we will learn about the various ways artists, from Joan Baez to Kendrick Lamar, align with and respond to artistic and political movements to foster civic engagement and fight for change. This course will offer pathways for students to explore a variety of scholarly topics in the arts and humanities.
